detailed_description: A fast 6B parameter text-to-image model with bilingual text rendering support.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Positive text prompt. Supports Chinese and English. Cannot exceed 800 characters.

parameters.name: image_path
parameters.description:
Support image URL. 
Supported image formats include.jpg / .jpeg / .png
The image file size cannot exceed 10MB, and the width and height dimensions of the image shall not be less than 300px, and the aspect ratio of the image should be between 1:2.5 ~ 2.5:1

parameters.name: guidance_scale
parameters.description: The measure of how close you want the model to stick to your prompt when generating the image.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: The height of the generated image. Total pixels must be between 512*512 and 2048*2048.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: The width of the generated image. Total pixels must be between 512*512 and 2048*2048.
